name: MLS Co., Ltd.
summary: MLS Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures light-emitting diode products in China and internationally. The company offers LED beads, filament, and chip, as well as backlight series and ceramic package; LED display beads-indoor and outdoor, as well as display module; AC/DC power adapter, LED lighting driver power series, and traditional and fast charger series; and LED bulb, tube, and strip, as well as rail light, magnetic lamp, downlight, ceiling light, chandelier, and switch products. It also provides magnetic track, wall washer, grille, linear, panel, pendant, and fan lights; rail, aluminum, and PC spotlights, as well as ultra-thin downlights, industrial and mining lamps, …
